name: week
title: Software renewal review
subtitle: Recorded commitments and usage evidence, not a vendor action

sections.title: Notice deadlines
sections.sql: select application,name,owner,notice_date,end_date,days_to_notice,contract_value,currency from renewal_calendar order by notice_date nulls first

sections.title: Licence position
sections.sql: select application,purchased_seats,assigned,stale_observations,inactive_candidates from licence_position order by application

sections.title: Needs attention
sections.sql: select entity,name,issue from attention_items order by entity,name

sections.title: Record checks
sections.sql: select entity,name,rule,finding from compliance_findings order by rule,name

sections.title: Recorded spend by currency
sections.sql: select currency,sum(amount) recorded_spend from expenses group by currency order by currency
